text:
anya: Quick sync for LumenWave VPC dry-run tomorrow morning. Need to confirm: peering routes to analytics VPC, shared NAT counts, KMS key owners, and CloudTrail delivery. Can we run a fast audit now? cc @sam @leo @priya :hourglass_flowing_sand

sam: on it. Priorities: prod, analytics-shared, and cache-private. I'll scan route tables + peering attachments.

leo: I'll validate CloudTrail -> S3 bucket + lifecycle + encryption. Reminder: bucket policy must deny PutObject unless kms:Encrypt is used for their CMK.

priya: KMS checklist: verify CMK admin principals, rotation status, key state (Enabled), and grants for redwood-audit role. Also need key creation date for the compliance sheet.

sam: ran `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=requester-vpc-info.vpc-id,Values=vpc-0a1b2c3`; peering id pcx-0ff1e2d3 attached to analytics-vpc. Route tables need explicit route to peer CIDR. Found missing route in prod-app-rtb.

anya: can you add the route and tag the change? We'll want that in the runbook as a remediation step so customer sees it after dry-run.

sam: patch submitted: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc123 --destination-cidr-block 10.20.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0ff1e2d3` — change id chg-0a9b8c7d. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0a9b8c7d) by sam at 2026-03-22T21:02:11Z

leo: CloudTrail: trail exists (lumenwave-audit), bucket lumenwave-audit-us-east-1. Bucket encryption: AES256 server-side, but not KMS. We should switch to CMK per their compliance. Also lifecycle shows 365d retention only; procurement asked for 7y option.

priya: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222233334444:key/9f8e7d6c was created 2024-11-02. Policy allows account-root and key admins but missing explicit service principal for CloudTrail. Example allow statement we need: "Principal": {"Service": "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"}. I'll draft the statement.

anya: good catch. Leo — can you add the KMS note to the CloudTrail run section and propose a migration step (enable kms, copy current S3 objects with SSE-KMS)? We need minimal downtime.

leo: yep. Proposed approach: create new KMS alias `alias/lumenwave-audit-kms`, update CloudTrail to use KMS, enable bucket default encryption to use that alias, then run a one-off S3 copy job to re-encrypt existing objects. I'll add commands to runbook.

sam: NATs: account currently has 2 NAT gateways in us-east-1 (nat-0a1, nat-0b2). Prod-app subnets are using nat-0a1; analytics subnets were pointing to an internet gateway (public) by mistake  flagged and switched to NAT route.

anya: excellent. Any open security-group egress holes?

sam: found a sg `sg-0d4e5f6` on cache that allowed 0.0.0.0/0 UDP ephemeral out — flagged as noncompliant. I'll tighten to known CDN ranges per their config.

priya: KMS perms sweep in progress. Noted grant exceptions for a Lambda in analytics account that needs Decrypt; will create a constrained grant rather than giving broad decrypt.

deploy-bot: compliance-bot: KMS policy change proposed in PR #3421 by priya.

anya: Renewal risk note: procurement asked for HSM (CloudHSM/KMS HSM) and extended retention SLA for audit logs. If we can't offer bundled HSM, risk becomes "elevated". Marco from solutions owes a cost delta; tagging @solutions (will send separately).

leo: I'll include the retention variance in the draft SOW notes. For the dry-run, ops team wants the trail + bucket + kms change in staging only.

sam: final artifacts uploaded: https://gist.github.com/redwood/lumenwave-network-snapshot (routes, rtb snapshots, nat list), https://gist.github.com/redwood/lumenwave-sg-export (SGs and flags)

priya: perms check done in staging. CloudTrail principal added to CMK policy, rotation on. I'll push policy JSON to the runbook.

anya: perfect. I'll update the onboarding runbook, add a renewal risk card on customer health with "HSM request - elevated" and share runbook with LumenWave ops for acknowledgment. Dry-run start 09:00 local tomorrow.

anya: thanks all, closing this thread.
